abstract: Covers the SPDX (System Package Data Exchange) specification from the Linux Foundation: the SPDX 3.0.1 RDF-based model with its profiles (Core, Software, Security, Licensing with SimpleLicensing and ExpandedLicensing, Dataset, AI, Build, Lite, Extension), Elements, Relationships, SpdxDocument, CreationInfo and the JSON-LD serialization; the SPDX 2.3 document structure (creation information, packages, files, snippets, other licensing information, relationships, annotations) with the 2.3.1 maintenance corrections; SPDX license expressions, LicenseRef- and AdditionRef- identifiers and SPDX-License-Identifier tags; the SPDX License List 3.29.0; and SBOMs that cover the NTIA 2021 and CISA 2026 minimum elements as SPDX maps them. Version lines: 3.0.1 is current, 2.3 is supported, 2.2 (ISO/IEC 5962:2021) and 2.1 and earlier are legacy, 3.1-RC1 is tracked as a preview, and the License List is its own family. SKILL.md holds the invariants and workflow; references split out the version lines and the 2.3 to 3.0 upgrade, the SPDX 3 model, SPDX 2.3 documents, license expressions, and SBOM minimum elements.
